items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die:
items.claim: Aaron and his sons were forbidden to drink wine or strong drink when entering the tabernacle
items.actor: thou, nor thy sons with thee

items.quote: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
items.claim: The prohibition shall be an everlasting statute

items.quote: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
items.claim: Aaron and his sons were to distinguish between holy and unholy, clean and unclean
items.object: holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean

items.quote: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
items.claim: Aaron and his sons were to teach the children of Israel the LORD's statutes as delivered through Moses
